widgets_values: A continuous realistic studio shot with exactly the same two adult women, the same faces, hair, natural gestures, two original beige paper cups and crossing motion. The curly-haired woman wears a plain deep-blue open-front knitted cardigan throughout. Preserve the original cardigan silhouette, folds, long sleeves and hems; it is already deep blue at the beginning and stays the same deep blue after the blonde woman occludes it. Her pale pink inner top is unchanged. Preserve all hands, skin and both cups as in the source. The blonde woman keeps her white blouse. Soft constant neutral studio lighting. Preserve source audio. Only the cardigan fabric color changes to deep blue; keep the original garment shape and pink inner top. No extra person, no extra hands, no text, no cuts.

widgets_values: 本工作流来自实际保存并通过导入/API/保存/重开的指定测试配方；对应成片已获人工接受。不是任意素材、模型或设备的效果保证。模型、LoRA顺序/强度、采样器、sigma及接线保持。请在加载节点选择自己的合法输入；示例媒体、引导静帧和权重不随GitHub上传。API图见同目录api；依赖和实际尺寸/时长见README。改变长链参数请使用新的chain_id。本例先以source_recolour给原片明确设色，再经原FL2VA模型低噪声细化；原生Karras rho1，20步，sigma0.06至0.001后归零，实际20次DiT。设色输入另存且不是模型结果；Decode直接接Composite，生成后没有RGB校色。这是指定纯换色配方的验收，不是任意服装款式/材质替换或模型原生通用去闪烁认证。
